rationale: A gesture recognizer that was only a CANDIDATE consumed the pointer: GestureArbiter reported consumption whenever any recognizer existed on the chain, so a widget that merely registered a gesture never received press, drag or release and was permanently undraggable while still painting normally. Reported as a large synth knob that could not be turned in Logic. The arbiter now reports a real CLAIM separately from candidacy, and every consumer gates on the claim. Pulp-only: the defect and the fix both originate here, with no counterpart framework change to backport.
